newsitem.title: USA: Southern Banc to buy up to 15 pct of shares.
newsitem.headline: Southern Banc to buy up to 15 pct of shares.

text.p: Southern Banc Co said Friday it would buy back up to 15 percent of its outstanding common stock, or 207,301 shares.
Chairman and President James Little said in a statement that management considers the company's common stock to be an "attractive investment."
The transactions will generally take place on the open market. Little did not rule out the possibility of unsolicited negotiated transactions or other types of repurchases.
The company said the number of repurchases would depend on market conditions.
Southern Banc said it expected a reduction in the number of outstanding shares would increase its per-share earnings and book value.
